newsitem.title: USA: Clinton meets Moroccan prince on peace process.
newsitem.headline: Clinton meets Moroccan prince on peace process.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton met with Morocco's Crown Prince Sidi Mohammed for about 20 minutes on Monday, discussing the Middle East peace process and other issues of concern in North Africa, the White House said.
White House spokesman Mike McCurry said the prince gave Clinton a letter from his father, King Hassan, outlining the king's views on the peace process.
He described the meeting as "a good exchange of views," but gave no further details.
